importantNotes: Chicago Neighborhood Soccer operates primarily through volunteer leadership, with no paid staff positions in FY2024.
All fundraising proceeds (100%) are redirected to community causes and program operations.
The organization received 501(c)(3) tax-exempt status in 2024.
As a small nonprofit with gross receipts under $50,000, NBHD Soccer files Form 990-N (e-Postcard) annually.
Program expenses reflect direct community impact through youth programming, pickup games, and charitable events.

* Board Personal Contributions: Technology services ($1,080 annual Meetup platform), insurance premiums ($770), nonprofit filing fees ($150), and promotional materials ($300) are personally funded by board members and not reflected in organizational expenses. This represents $2,300 in additional annual value contributed to the community at no cost to the organization.
